# UX Requirements Checklist: GymTracker v1

**Purpose**: Validate that requirements governing the user interface — state presentation, error surfacing, navigation, input behavior, and accessibility — are specified rather than left to implementer discretion.
**Created**: 2026-09-30
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are empty-state requirements defined for every screen, or only for progress trends? [Gap, Spec §FR-034] — resolved by FR-034a
- [x] CHK002 Are loading-state requirements defined for any asynchronous data retrieval? [Gap] — resolved by FR-034b
- [x] CHK003 Are navigation requirements defined for how the user moves between workouts, exercises, body weight, nutrition, goals, and progress? [Gap] — resolved by FR-034c
- [x] CHK004 Are requirements defined for the default date pre-filled on entry forms? [Gap, Spec §FR-005, §FR-012, §FR-019] — resolved by FR-034d
- [x] CHK005 Is the default progress date range stated as a requirement rather than only as an assumption? [Gap, Spec §FR-030a vs §Assumptions] — resolved by FR-030d
- [x] CHK006 Are success-feedback requirements defined for completed save operations? [Gap, Spec §FR-038] — resolved by FR-038d
- [x] CHK007 Are requirements defined for warning the user about unsaved changes before navigating away? [Gap] — resolved as out of scope: no form in v1 spans more than one screen, and FR-038d plus FR-038e make save outcomes unambiguous
- [x] CHK008 Are accessibility requirements defined for keyboard navigation, form labelling, and assistive technology? [Gap, Coverage] — resolved by FR-050 through FR-054
- [x] CHK009 Are requirements defined for how archived items are visually distinguished within historical records? [Gap, Spec §FR-004, Contract §Workouts] — resolved by FR-004d (labelled "Archived")
- [x] CHK010 Are requirements defined for the ordering and labelling of meal slots? [Gap, Spec §FR-022] — resolved by FR-022a
- [x] CHK011 Are food search result ordering and result-count limit requirements specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-017, §Edge Cases] — resolved by FR-017a

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK012 Is "clearly distinguish exceeding a goal from being under it" defined with specific, observable visual criteria? [Clarity, Spec §FR-027] — resolved by FR-027a (negative remaining plus "over by N" text)
- [x] CHK013 Is "report failures visibly to the user" specific about placement, persistence, and dismissal of the message? [Clarity, Spec §FR-038] — resolved by FR-038e
- [x] CHK014 Is "indicate that no goals applied" defined concretely enough that two implementers would produce the same result? [Clarity, Spec §FR-028] — resolved by FR-028a, which fixes the wording and the route offered
- [x] CHK015 Is "an explicit empty state" defined beyond "not a blank or broken chart"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-034] — resolved by FR-034a (one-sentence explanation plus primary action)
- [x] CHK016 Is "responsive layout is desirable" measurable, or should it be stated as in or out of scope? [Ambiguity, Spec §Assumptions] — resolved: §Assumptions now sets a 1024 px minimum and puts responsive layout out of scope
- [x] CHK017 Is "informing the user it was updated" specified as to mechanism and timing? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013] — resolved by FR-013a
- [x] CHK018 Is the requirement that messages name the offending field accompanied by a requirement to associate the message with the corresponding input? [Clarity, Spec §FR-036] — resolved by FR-052

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK019 Are error-presentation requirements consistent across all data-entry screens? [Consistency, Spec §FR-036, §FR-038] — resolved by FR-038e, which mandates one location and one behavior everywhere
- [x] CHK020 Are the requirements for rejecting invalid input consistent about whether validation occurs on submit, on blur, or continuously? [Gap, Consistency] — resolved by FR-036b (on submit, server authoritative)
- [x] CHK021 Are list-ordering requirements consistent across workout history, body weight history, and goal history? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, §FR-015, §FR-025a] — resolved by FR-034e
- [x] CHK022 Is the terminology for archive, restore, and delete used consistently across exercise and food requirements? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, §FR-024b] — verified: FR-004c through FR-004e now state the shared rules once, in one vocabulary

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK023 Are requirements defined for the first-run experience, where every screen is empty until the demo is loaded? [Coverage, Spec §FR-043] — resolved by FR-043a
- [x] CHK024 Are requirements defined for rendering a trend containing exactly one data point? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-034] — resolved by FR-034f
- [x] CHK025 Are requirements defined for presenting a food search that returns a very large number of matches? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases] — resolved by FR-017a (alphabetical, 25 default / 100 max)
- [x] CHK026 Are requirements defined for the editing flow when a user removes the last set from a session? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases] — resolved by FR-005b
- [x] CHK027 Are requirements defined for the state of the progress view after an invalid date range is rejected? [Coverage, Spec §FR-030b] — verified: FR-030b requires the previous view to remain intact

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK028 Are the task-completion time criteria accompanied by defined starting conditions that make them reproducible? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, §SC-002, §SC-003] — resolved: §Measurable Outcomes now fixes the starting screen, dataset, and input method
- [x] CHK029 Is "no screen showing an empty state" verifiable given that empty states are themselves required behavior elsewhere? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-008 vs §FR-034] — resolved by rewritten SC-008
- [x] CHK030 Can "the user cannot tell whether their data was saved" be evaluated objectively? [Measurability, Spec §SC-010] — resolved by rewritten SC-010: every operation ends in exactly one of two observable states

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK031 Is the desktop-browser assumption stated with a concrete minimum, or left as "current evergreen"? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions] — resolved: named browsers from the last two years, 1024 px minimum viewport
- [x] CHK032 Is the assumption that charts need no interactivity validated against the progress scenarios that reference specific data points? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, §FR-030] — resolved: §Assumptions states charts are non-interactive and FR-054's text summary is how individual values are read

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
